subject.title: message tool fails to deliver files/images on Feishu (400 volc-dcdn / write ECONNRESET) while same Lark SDK upload succeeds standalone

question: Should maintainers land the open Feishu multipart-normalization PR as the fix for this issue, or ask for a different wrapper-boundary repair?
rationale: The issue has an open proof-positive fix candidate, but this read-only cleanup pass cannot make the final maintainer merge decision for a Feishu media-delivery transport change.

options.title: Review and land linked PR
